Decimal is preferable for currency because it represents base-10 values exactly, so amounts like 0.10 and 19.99 do not suffer from binary rounding errors. Binary floating point is optimized for scientific computation, but it can introduce tiny precision errors that accumulate and produce incorrect cents in financial calculations.
